_note: Carrier base on the Thinking core (P3.3; owner rulings 302 A, 306 A, 333 B) launch spec for package_launch.sh. It runs AFTER the P3.2 packets chain (carrier_think_packets_launch_spec.json) has promoted and sealed the Thinking packets of every carrier: the derive step pins the real packet artifacts with --require-receipts and REFUSES when one is absent (a zero sentinel is refused by the flip anyway). The coordinator registers with `--root-countersign --until commit`; the queue hook scripts/flights/batch/queue/queue_carriers_after.sh does the same on the coordinator's standing authority when installed with --register, then flips and starts the chain. The write step passes --no-derive so it cannot undo the pins, and --registered-at {utc} because a first registration has no registered-facts file to inherit a stamp from. The chain wrapper (scripts/flights/batch/queue/chain_carrierthink.sh, installed at /home/chao/saea-queue/chain_carrierthink.sh) swaps to the SLURP lock's Thinking session itself; no new Windows serving task exists. The Windows task SAEA-Chain-CARRIERTHINK must be registered first.
